entries.name: @google/genai
entries.effects: Registry installation runs the no-op preinstall command. npm does not run prepare when installing this registry tarball, whose packed files omit scripts/prepare.js.
entries.justification: Transitive dependency of the exact Pi 0.84.2 peer tree; required by Pi's Google provider integration.

entries.name: protobufjs

scripts.prepublish: cd cli && npm install && cd .. && npm run build

entries.effects: Registry installation runs postinstall, which checks a dependent package's protobufjs version prefix and only warns on incompatibility. The source-package prepublish build is not run when installing the registry tarball.
entries.justification: Transitive serialization dependency of @google/genai in the exact Pi 0.84.2 peer tree.
